instructions: GVDEditor edits timetables (grafikon) of INISS, the Slovak and Czech railway station information system (boards and announcements). Tools read the timetable open in the running editor including unsaved changes; list_grafikons shows the other timetables of the installation. Train data use Slovak terms: routing originates/passes/terminates, validity is a calendar restriction text (explain_validity expands it to days), TabTab is the INISS language deciding what boards show - read tabtab_reference before explaining it and do not guess its semantics. Tools that change the timetable work in the editor's memory only: each call is one undo step the user can revert in GVDEditor, nothing is saved - the user reviews the changes and saves the timetable. Call a change with dryRun first when its effect is not obvious.
instructionsWithoutChanges: GVDEditor edits timetables (grafikon) of INISS, the Slovak and Czech railway station information system (boards and announcements). Tools read the timetable open in the running editor including unsaved changes; list_grafikons shows the other timetables of the installation. Train data use Slovak terms: routing originates/passes/terminates, validity is a calendar restriction text (explain_validity expands it to days), TabTab is the INISS language deciding what boards show - read tabtab_reference before explaining it and do not guess its semantics. Changes are made by the user in GVDEditor.

tools.description: Checks the open timetable like the Analysis window of GVDEditor: validity, trains, boards, TabTab, state diagram, recordings and INISS settings of the selected run configuration. tools.name: prepare_simulator
tools.title: Prepare board simulator
tools.description: Creates the lines and boards of the station in the board simulator (TableSimulator) like 'Prepare in the simulator' in GVDEditor: lines of the selected run configuration with the boards INISS assigns to them, their faces, virtual boards from the XML export and the INISS log folder. tools.name: set_tabtab
tools.title: Set TabTab section
tools.description: Changes the text or the key of a TabTab section, or creates a section when the key is new. The text is checked like in the TabTab editor: an error it did not have before refuses the change, the remaining findings come back. Read tabtab_reference first and check the result for a train with preview_board_text.

key.description: Section key; a new section is created when none has it.

text.description: Whole text of the section (INISS board language, see tabtab_reference).

newKey.description: New key (rename); catalog board columns keep using the section.

dryRun.description: Only report the result; the timetable stays as it is.
Dry run only - the timetable stays as it was.

changed.description: The timetable is (or would be) different; false = it already was in that state.

undoStep.description: Undo step the user sees in GVDEditor (Edit > Undo); null = no step. The change is not saved - the user saves the timetable.

tabTab.description: The section after the change with its check findings; null = deleted.

text.description: Program text of the section (INISS board language, see tabtab_reference).

elen.description: Meaning on ELEN boards: colour, blinking, tall digits, face, extended font.

boards.description: Physical boards (keys) of this catalog type.

tools.name: set_train
tools.title: Set train
tools.description: Changes a train (id) or adds one - empty or as a copy of another train (copyFrom) - with the checks of the Edit train window: errors refuse the change, warnings are returned. Only the given values change; the station lists replace the whole part of the route (get_train gives the current one). GVDEditor numbers the variants; supplements and formations stay (a copy takes them over). A new train has no board texts - regenerate_board_texts with onlyMissing adds them. Train ids are positions in the list.

id.description: Train id from list_trains; null = a new train.

copyFrom.description: Id of the train a new one starts as a copy of.

type.description: Train type key, e.g. Os, R (get_station).

name.description: Train name; a name from the sound bank is stored as its sound key.

arrival.description: Arrival time HH:mm; used when the train has stations before this one.

departure.description: Departure time HH:mm; used when the train has stations after this one.

departureTrack.description: Departure track key; the arrival track = the same track.

lineArrival.description: Line of arrival (up to 20 letters and digits); empty = none.

validity.description: Calendar restriction text, e.g. 'jazdí v 1-5' (explain_validity); empty = daily.

stationsBefore.description: Stations before this station (where the train comes from), in order; empty = the train originates here.

station.description: Station name or number (the number when more stations have the name).

stationsAfter.description: Stations after this station (where the train goes), in order; empty = the train terminates here.

station.description: Station name or number (the number when more stations have the name).

stationsBefore.description: Stations before this station (where the train comes from), in order.
